live.disabledReason: Trading through Alpaca isn't set up. The app reads prices with its Alpaca key and never sends an order with it.
notes: Needs a trading account the person authorises (OAuth with the separate trading scope), with credentials held on the server.
US stocks, ETFs and crypto only — Alpaca does not offer ASX securities.
Fractional and notional orders are day orders; crypto takes market, limit and stop-limit with GTC or IOC.

live.disabledReason: Your broker connection is read-only. It shows holdings and can't place orders.
notes: A read-only connection is never treated as permission to trade.
Trading needs a connection made with trade access, and only some brokers offer it (CommSec and Interactive Brokers are read-only through SnapTrade).

live.disabledReason: No crypto exchange is connected for trading.
notes: Spot only. No margin, futures or withdrawals.
Simulated fills against live quotes. No order leaves this app.
No leverage, margin, short selling or withdrawals.
